berlin_core_awakening.title: The Berlin Core: Awakening
berlin_core_awakening.description: You've heard whispers of a powerful fusion core beneath the Fernsehturm, capable of restoring Berlin. But first, you need to understand the city and its factions.

objectives.description: Engage with key faction leaders: Generaloberst Von Stahl (Reichstag), Mother Renate (Tempelhof), Merchant Jakob (Potsdamer Platz), Der Schwertmeister (Spandau Citadel), The Archivist (Stasi Museum), and Iron-Tooth Lena (Wedding Ghetto).
Gather information about The Berlin Core.

first_steps.title: First Steps
first_steps.description: Learn to survive in the Berlin wasteland.

objectives.description: Explore Checkpoint Charlie Market

lost_currywurst.title: The Lost Currywurst
lost_currywurst.description: Find the legendary preserved Currywurst for Trader Charlie.

objectives.description: Search Alexanderplatz for the Currywurst

green_thumb.title: Green Thumb
green_thumb.description: Mother Renate needs mutated seeds from the Tiergarten. They are fungus-choked and require purification, and Radhunde are threatening the nursery.

objectives.description: Find Mutated Seeds in Tiergarten
Take the Mutated Seeds to Mehmet the Mutant in Kreuzberg for purification
Clear the Radhunde pack from the North Hangar nursery (Tempelhof)
Return the purified seeds to Mother Renate

iron_will.title: Iron Will
iron_will.description: General Von Stahl wants you to retrieve a data drive containing information on 'Phantom Citizens' from a fallen scout in the Fernsehturm.

objectives.description: Find the Iron Ring Data Drive in Fernsehturm

bureaucrats_nightmare.title: The Bureaucrat's Nightmare
bureaucrats_nightmare.description: Hauptmann Richter needs proper paperwork filed to authorize a supply run. This involves navigating the labyrinthine Bürgeramt.

objectives.description: Find Anmeldung Form 27-B in the Mitte Ruins
Get the form stamped by the Werkbund at Brandenburg Gate
Return the completed paperwork to Richter

the_perfect_gift.title: The Perfect Gift
the_perfect_gift.description: Retrieve a pre-war engagement ring from the KaDeWe ruins for a romantic scavenger, navigating the dangerous Kaufhaus-Feral-Ghouls.

objectives.description: Search Floor 6 of KaDeWe Ruins
Find the Pre-War Engagement Ring

the_theft_of_berlin.title: The Theft of Berlin
the_theft_of_berlin.description: Steal the Nefertiti Bust from Museum Island, which is now a Super Mutant stronghold.

objectives.description: Infiltrate the Neues Museum on Museum Island
Steal the Nefertiti Bust

ringbahn_restoration.title: The Ringbahn Restoration
ringbahn_restoration.description: Repair the three major breaks in the 37km S-Bahn loop to enable fast travel and resource flow across Berlin.

objectives.description: Clear the 'Gleisdreieck' of Radhunde
Negotiate with the Bundesritter for replacement rails (Spandau Citadel)
Defend the repair crew from a Wall Breaker assault

bureaucracy_blues.title: Bureaucracy Blues
bureaucracy_blues.description: Obtain a 'Universal Crossing Permit' by navigating the Bürgeramt's insane requirements, including a combat trial and a missing signature.

objectives.description: Fill out Anmeldung Form 27-B at the Auto-Clerk (Bürgeramt)
Get a 'Physical Aptitude Stamp' (requires a combat trial)
Find the 'Missing Signature' in the flooded basement of the Formulars-Komplex
Return the completed permit papers to The Archivist

the_pfand_path.title: The Pfand Path
the_pfand_path.description: Learn about the unique Pfand economy of Berlin by collecting bottles, finding the Pfandautomat, and exchanging them for a special döner.

objectives.description: Collect 5 empty bottles in the Mitte Ruins
Find the Kotti Pfandautomat
Exchange bottles for Pfand-Tokens
Buy a 'Döner (Special Meat)' from Mehmet the Mutant in Kreuzberg

unit_247_repair.title: Unit 247's Malfunction
unit_247_repair.description: Unit 247, a Broker Protectron, is malfunctioning and needs spare parts to access non-critical intel.

objectives.description: Find Protectron Spare Parts
Return the parts to Unit 247

klaus_record_hunt.title: Klaus's Record Hunt
klaus_record_hunt.description: Kreuzberg-Klaus, the ghoul DJ, wants you to retrieve his stolen records from a former Club-Mate storage facility.

objectives.description: Find Klaus's stolen records

doner_mafia_protection.title: Döner Mafia Protection
doner_mafia_protection.description: Patron Osman needs you to clear out Wall Breaker raiders who are interfering with his döner supply routes from Wedding.

objectives.description: Clear 5 Wall Breaker Raiders from Wedding supply routes

story_for_gaertner.title: A Story for the Gärtner
story_for_gaertner.description: Der Gärtner, the hermit of Grunewald, will guide you through the dangerous forest if you tell him a true story from the outside.

objectives.description: Tell Der Gärtner a true story from the outside

vault_b12_key_quest.title: The Vault B-12 Key
vault_b12_key_quest.description: Der Gärtner has hinted at a key to Vault B-12, hidden in Teufelsberg. You need to find it from the mutated birds that nest there.

objectives.description: Find the Vault B-12 Key from mutated birds on Teufelsberg

richter_moral_dilemma.title: Richter's Moral Dilemma
richter_moral_dilemma.description: Hauptmann Richter, the Iron Ring officer, is suffering from nightly breakdowns. You can either exploit his weakness for your own gain or try to help him.

objectives.description: Exploit Richter's weakness for personal gain (e.g., gain access to Iron Ring supplies)
Help Richter overcome his mental distress

squire_trial.title: The Squire's Trial
squire_trial.description: Der Schwertmeister challenges you to a trial to prove your worth and begin your journey as a Bundesritter Squire.

objectives.description: Defeat the Bundesritter training bot in the arena
Retrieve an ancient German history text from the Spandau archives

archive_job.title: The Archive Job
archive_job.description: The Archivist of the Schattenvolk needs you to retrieve a specific pre-war data chip from the heavily guarded lower levels of the Stasi Museum.

objectives.description: Infiltrate the secure Stasi archives (Level 9-15)
Retrieve the 'Pre-War Bioweapon Data Chip'

lena_demolition_mission.title: Lena's Demolition Mission
lena_demolition_mission.description: Iron-Tooth Lena wants you to demonstrate your loyalty to the Wall Breakers by destroying a symbolic structure of Iron Ring propaganda near Alexanderplatz.

objectives.description: Destroy the Iron Ring Propaganda Tower near Alexanderplatz
